description: This PHP class, ZendeskHelpProcessor, implements HelpProcessor and manages interactions with a Zendesk help center, including constructing URLs for search and redirection, and sending HTTP queries to fetch help article data.

classes.name: ZendeskHelpProcessor
classes.description: A class responsible for processing help topics via Zendesk API, including generating URLs for help articles, executing search queries, and handling redirects.

methods.name: getHelpConfigService
methods.description: Returns an instance of HelpConfigService, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getHttpClient
methods.description: Returns an instance of GuzzleHttp Client, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the base URL of the help center from configuration.

methods.name: getSearchUrl
methods.description: Constructs and returns the search URL for a given help label.

methods.name: getRedirectUrl
methods.description: Performs a search for a help label and returns the redirect URL to the first matching help article if found.

methods.name: sendQuery
methods.description: Sends an HTTP GET request to the specified URL and returns the response data for further processing.

methods.name: getDefaultRedirectUrl
methods.description: Returns the default redirect URL of the help center.
